news.title: Americans’ Views of ICE Grow More Negative
news.summary_en: A majority of Americans (56%) now say they have an unfavorable opinion of Immigration and Customs Enforcement.

news.title: How Americans View Federal Agencies
news.summary_en: Americans view eight of 12 federal agencies we asked about more favorably than unfavorably. The National Park Service, National Weather Service and U.S. Postal Service are viewed especially positively.

news.title: Why Is Election Day on a Tuesday in the U.S., and How Many Other Countries Have Weekday Elections?
news.summary_en: The U.S. is one of 28 democratic countries that routinely holds national elections on non-holiday weekdays.

news.title: Few Americans Say They Are Asking AI Chatbots for 2026 Election Information
news.summary_en: Among the 8% of U.S. adults using chatbots for this purpose, most have sought information about candidates or issues in the elections.

news.title: Growing Share of Americans Say Social Media Is an Important News Source for Them
news.summary_en: A majority of U.S. adults (58%) now say social media is an important way for them to keep up with the news.
